g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 30-minute reward before an opt-in game, and the decline path leaves reading unchanged. The trigger requires a loaded game, and the ad-failure field describes a path when the game closes.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored stories, not cash or a transferable equivalent.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger uses an article-open counter and a return to the home feed, not chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds and decline fields leave existing reading, saving, and sharing available; the reward temporarily hides sponsored cards.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a banner under the category pills on the content-safe s01 home feed, not inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This product change gives the player a 30-minute cleaner reading experience for their own use in the observed story-reading core flow f01.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' and rationale fields assert that the app has no paywall or locked content and that its native ads are cheap or low-value. The model records only that no paywall or limit was seen on the home feed; m01 supports uneven ad fill, not ad value.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The product model shows no paid plan, and the subscribers field says members of a future ad-free plan would not see the offer.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 30 minutes and does not grant lasting access to a paid benefit or take an ordered-feed advantage from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger places the offer on the home feed after the reader returns from an article, rather than interrupting an article in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The ad-failure field and flow grant the reward when the game closes, played or not. Simula requires granting it only after REWARD_VERIFIED.

c7_specific.reason: The proposal names the home-feed sponsored slot at s01.e44 and the in-article sponsored card at s02.e13 as the placements the reward would hide.

other_concern: Whether one rewarded game offsets the revenue from hiding sponsored cards for 30 minutes needs testing.
